alpha-delivery.name: Alpha delivery
alpha-delivery.purpose: Deliver the alpha event and record the correlated middle event.

failureRecovery: On timeout, retry with the retained alpha event identifier

alpha-observability.purpose: Record synthetic trace evidence for alpha delivery.
preconditions: Caller-local synthetic trace collection is enabled
failureRecovery: On timeout, repeat trace collection with the same synthetic identifier

middle-operations.rawContent:
﻿# Middle operations notes

Use only synthetic identifiers when recording examples.
A literal ```` run remains data.
Café stays decomposed.

scenarioPolicy: These are synthetic fixture operations, not production storefront operations. operationDefaults explicitly establishes known absence only for operations declared in this source. Missing facts outside this enumerated policy remain unknown. These operations impose no additional convention dependencies beyond their selected Data Representation rules. Workflow coordination is caller-local: identifiers, trace records, and state labels are not message headers or payload fields. Local orchestration timeouts do not imply a messaging reply.
